newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech TV station Nova's market share dips.
newsitem.headline: Czech TV station Nova's market share dips.

text.p: Market share held by Nova, the dominant Czech commercial TV station, dipped in the third quarter but it widened its lead over its closest rival, public channel CT1, a market research report released on Thursday said.

Nova, launched in 1994 and majority-owned by Central European Media Enterprises Ltd, dipped to 65.0 percent average viewership in the third quarter from 65.4 percent in the second, the study by research firms GfK and Median said.

CT1's audience share fell 1.7 percentage points to 24.1 percent in the third quarter, but the second nationwide commercial station Premiera's share rose to 4.2 percent from 3.3 while public broadcaster CT2 rose to 3.8 percent from 3.5.
The study sampled a cross section of 7,681 respondents asking them their viewing choices from the previous day.
